date_note: The ministry's press release, relayed on 20 November by ORF and vol.at, is the first page read; the unauthorised access itself is stated as 12 to 13 November.
title: Austria's foreign ministry says unauthorised access to a website run by an external provider exposed staff contact data
org: Austrian Federal Ministry for European and International Affairs (BMEIA)
summary: Austria's foreign ministry said in a press release, relayed by ORF and vol.at, that there was unauthorised access to a website run by an external service provider on 12 and 13 November. The ministry said it noticed the access on 13 November and stopped it immediately. It said names and official contact details of staff at its head office and foreign representations were affected, and that no personal data of citizens was.
plain: Austria's foreign ministry says someone gained unauthorised access to a provider's website. It says staff names and work contact details were affected, not citizens' data.
exec: A government ministry says staff contact details were exposed through an outside provider's website; the ministry says citizens' data was not affected.

validation.note: ORF and vol.at both relay the ministry's press release (apparently the same agency report), so they count as one account; the ministry's own release was not read. The Die Presse page could not be loaded.
